info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Replace Hotel Rooms Upgrade-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Upgrade Management API facilitates the batch upgrading of hotel room allocations. This powerful endpoint allows businesses to efficiently manage room upgrades, ensuring that resources can be allocated effectively to meet customer demands. Typical consumers include hotel management systems and booking platforms, which utilize this API to streamline operational workflows and improve guest experiences. With the ability to update room statuses in bulk, hotels can enhance their service offerings and optimize occupancy rates.

put.summary: Upgrade a room to a higher category.
put.description: This operation allows users to upgrade their current room to a higher category, providing enhanced features and amenities. The request requires the current room details and the desired room category.

requestBody.description: Request body for upgrading a room. This request allows you to specify the details for the room upgrade, including the desired room features and preferences.
